title: Fifty years of 25 April
summary: The fiftieth anniversary of the coup was marked on 25 April 2024 by a solemn session in parliament and by the march down the Avenida da Liberdade, three weeks after a legislative election that had changed the arithmetic of the chamber it was held in.
